title: Normal maximal quotients and stabilizer surjectivity for a finite invariant-ring action
statement: Let $S$ be a commutative ring and let $H$ be a finite group acting on $S$ by ring automorphisms. Let $R\subseteq S$ be a subring fixed pointwise by $H$, and suppose $R=S^H:=\{s\in S:h(s)=s\text{ for every }h\in H\}$. Let $\mathfrak q\subset S$ and $\mathfrak p\subset R$ be maximal ideals with $\mathfrak q\cap R=\mathfrak p$. Set $F=R/\mathfrak p$ and $E=S/\mathfrak q$, regarded as residue fields [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], with their induced field extension $E/F$ [def-pc-field-extension]. Then $E/F$ is algebraic and normal: for every $x\in E$, its minimal polynomial over $F$ splits into linear factors over $E$. Moreover, writing $D_H(\mathfrak q)=\{h\in H:h(\mathfrak q)=\mathfrak q\}$, the homomorphism $D_H(\mathfrak q)\to\operatorname{Aut}_F(E)$ given by $h\mapsto(\bar s\mapsto\overline{h(s)})$ is surjective. The action on $S$ need not be faithful, and no separability of $E/F$ is assumed.
